message.text: I am examining `memo_service_webhooks.go` and `internal/webhook/webhook.go` to identify the webhook dispatcher, delivery package, and signing mechanism.

The dispatcher is `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`, called from the handler and defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. The delivery package is `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/webhook`.

The signing mechanism is HMAC-SHA256. Requests include headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature` with value `v1,base64(HMAC-SHA256(msgID.timestamp.body))`.

q22.
DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go; internal/webhook; HMAC-SHA256 (Standard Webhooks)

`CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls that dispatcher, which loads the creator’s webhooks and `webhook.PostAsync`. `internal/webhook/webhook.go` POSTs JSON and, when a secret is set, signs with HMAC-SHA256 over `msg_id.timestamp.body` and sends `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, and `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>`.
